description: Path guard corpus (C001-NFR-201, C001-REQ-1103, C001-REQ-1104). Placeholders are resolved by tests/guards/path-corpus.test.ts against a fixture built from `fixture`. `expect` is allow/deny, or per platform. Cases with `platforms` run only there; `requires` names a capability the test probes first.

placeholders.{repo-nodrive\\}: {repo\} without its drive letter and colon
placeholders.{repo2}: a second repository whose .sdd/ is a junction to its src/
placeholders.{shortname:rel}: 8.3 short name of the last segment of {repo}/rel

cases.note: percent-encoding is a literal folder name
link/.. is the link target's parent (POSIX)
Windows applies .. before links: the write lands in src/ although the physical walk stays in .sdd/
relative to cwd this is src/.sdd/
session started through a junction to the repository
through a link to the repository root, back into .sdd/
a different spelling of the repository than cwd; denied (fail closed)
short name of .sdd/ itself; denied (fail closed)
short name of a folder inside .sdd/
short name of a junction to source-code-folder/
the memory folder is a junction to src/
no tool name: not a write tool
